spells.name: Echo Strike
spells.description: Your next successful attack echoes after a delay, dealing half its wound damage, rounded down.

casting_help.use_once: Cast Echo Strike once at the first available opening; opening spells queue behind each other.
casting_help.manual: Only cast Echo Strike when you press its button during combat.
casting_help.as_often_as_possible: Recast when casting is allowed and no echo is armed. Pending echoes continue independently.

spells.name: Chronoblur
spells.description: For 60 seconds, movement in the previous second grants +4 melee defense and makes missile attacks treat you as 20 feet farther away.

casting_help.use_once: Cast Chronoblur once at the first available opening; opening spells queue behind each other.
casting_help.manual: Only cast Chronoblur when you press its button during combat.
casting_help.as_often_as_possible: Recast Chronoblur when casting is allowed and its movement-based defense buff has expired.

spells.name: Streamline
spells.description: For 5 minutes, damage dice against targets within 30 feet use their mathematical average, rounded down, before modifiers and damage reduction.

casting_help.use_once: Cast Streamline once at the first available opening; opening spells queue behind each other.
casting_help.manual: Only cast Streamline when you press its button during combat.
casting_help.as_often_as_possible: Recast Streamline when casting is allowed and its damage-averaging field has expired.
